correctness.rationale: With the stated shift convention and gh(hg)^−1, the lamp coordinate is (I−σ^t)x+(σ^s−I)y and the top coordinate is zero. For fixed s,t its image is the subgroup of vectors summing to zero per coset of H=<s,t>: edge differences cancel there, and along a spanning tree of each coset they generate every zero-sum vector by moving each leaf value to the root. This does not divide in A. The image has m^(N−[B:H]) elements, so each nonempty fiber has m^(N+[B:H]) elements. This includes the trivial top group. For C_n, grouping by gcd(n,s,t) gives the Jordan count by inclusion–exclusion, and the generating pair (1,0) gives the entire augmentation kernel. For prime n only the d=1 summand survives on nonzero targets in that kernel. For composite n a difference at positions 0,d with 1<d<n and d|n has additional strictly positive summands that the difference at 0,1 cannot have. The n=10 contributions 147456, 98304 and 98304 agree with the two displayed fiber levels. The finite checker and its output were inspected, not rerun; they supplement, rather than prove, the group-uniform argument.
